_about: Hand-written categories for core laws that appear in no Pakistan Code category listing (backend/storage/kb/category_map.json), so the Research and Knowledge Base filters can still find them. Applied only when the listing gives no category; a Pakistan Code category always wins. Records and the UI mark these as category_source 'LegalEase override'. Decided 2026-10-07 (kb-v2 B6). corpus_titles are the old-index source names of the same law, so old-index passages get the category too.

overrides.title: Pakistan Penal Code, 1860
overrides.reason: The substantive criminal code (offences and punishments); not in the site's Criminal Laws listing, which lists 44 of 69.

overrides.title: Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
overrides.reason: The criminal procedure code (FIR, arrest, bail, trial); not in the site's Criminal Laws listing.

overrides.title: Qanun-e-Shahadat Order, 1984
overrides.reason: Pakistan's law of evidence (replaced the Evidence Act 1872); the site's Law of Evidence listing shows one other Act.

overrides.title: Muslim Family Laws Ordinance, 1961
overrides.reason: Marriage registration, polygamy, talaq, maintenance and dower for Muslims; not in the site's Family Laws listing (19 Acts).
corpus_titles: THE MUSLIM FAMILY LAWS ORDINAN CE, 1961

overrides.title: West Pakistan Family Courts Act, 1964
overrides.reason: Establishes Family Courts and their jurisdiction (Schedule: dissolution, dower, maintenance, custody, dowry); not in the site's Family Laws listing.
corpus_titles: THE WEST PAKISTAN FAMILY COURTS ACT, 1964

overrides.title: West Pakistan Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1962
overrides.reason: Makes Muslim personal law the rule of decision in succession, marriage, divorce, dower and guardianship; user-supplied PDF, not in any listing.

overrides.title: Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1973
overrides.reason: The Constitution is in no Pakistan Code category; 'Constitutional Law' is a new LegalEase category used only for it.
corpus_titles: THE CONSTITUTION OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF PAKISTAN [As modified upto the 31st May, 2018
